configure. The domain starts in PENDING status until DNS is verified.

domain if you want to use it again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the domain to delete.

post.summary: SetMailFromDomain configures a custom MAIL FROM subdomain.
post.description:
This improves email deliverability by letting you control the Return-Path
header used for bounce handling. The subdomain must be part of your
verified domain.

Example: If your domain is "example.com", set mail_from to "mail.example.com"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the domain to configure.

get.summary: GetDomainRecords returns all DNS records needed for full email deliverability.
get.description:
This includes:
  - DKIM records (3 CNAMEs) - Required for email signing/authentication
  - SPF record (TXT) - Authorizes SES to send on your behalf
  - DMARC record (TXT) - Policy for handling authentication failures
  - MX record - Required for receiving inbound emails
  - MAIL FROM records (MX + TXT) - Improves deliverability and bounce handling

Each record includes its current verification status and instructions.

post.summary: VerifyDomain refreshes verification status from AWS SES.
post.description:
Call this after configuring your DNS records to check if they have
propagated and been verified by AWS. DNS propagation can take up to 72 hours.
This endpoint is rate-limited to prevent SES API abuse. If called too
frequently, it will return cached data with was_refreshed=false.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the domain to verify.

v1DomainStatus.description:
DomainStatus represents the verification status of a domain.

 - DOMAIN_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default value, should not be used.
 - DOMAIN_STATUS_PENDING: Domain is pending verification. Configure DNS records and call VerifyDomain.
 - DOMAIN_STATUS_SUCCESS: Domain has been successfully verified and is ready for sending.
 - DOMAIN_STATUS_FAILED: Domain verification failed. Check DNS configuration and try again.
 - DOMAIN_STATUS_TEMPORARY_FAILURE: Temporary verification failure. Will be retried automatically.

v1RecordStatus.description:
RecordStatus represents the verification status of an individual DNS record.

 - RECORD_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default value, should not be used.
 - RECORD_STATUS_PENDING: Record has not been verified yet.
 - RECORD_STATUS_VERIFIED: Record has been verified successfully.
 - RECORD_STATUS_FAILED: Record verification failed.

v1RecordType.description:
RecordType identifies the type and purpose of a DNS record.

 - RECORD_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value, should not be used.
 - RECORD_TYPE_DKIM: DKIM record for email signing. There are 3 CNAME records.
 - RECORD_TYPE_SPF: SPF record authorizing SES to send emails.
 - RECORD_TYPE_DMARC: DMARC record for authentication policy.
 - RECORD_TYPE_MX_INBOUND: MX record for receiving inbound emails.
 - RECORD_TYPE_MAIL_FROM_MX: MX record for custom MAIL FROM domain.
 - RECORD_TYPE_MAIL_FROM_SPF: SPF record for custom MAIL FROM domain.
